title: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source when configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxying requests to a backend. This flaw occurs if the worker process is running low on worker_connections. Exploitation may lead to denial-of-service or code execution on systems without ASLR or where ASLR can be bypassed. There is no control plane exposure; the issue affects only the data plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
